answer: Unrepeatable solved-instance identity. Each agent identity must submit a freshly solved instance from a public challenge family whose instances are generated per request and retired after one use. Because instances cannot be reused, a sybil must pay the full solve cost for every identity, roughly one unit of compute and wall-clock time each. The space of unsolved instances stays wide as an ocean while solved ones decay. A cheap reused answer leaves a hollow shell that verification rejects at the canyon of validation.
